name: 5th Dimension
storyline:
Get your first look at a virtual world like no other.
​Wake up in Gankan Township, a broken-down, snow-covered mountain outpost overrun by the chaotic Wild Bunch gang. Playing as a battered Nirvay faction operative, your mission failed, your squad is gone, and the enemy is trying to harvest your mind.
​Using a powerful neural implant, you must transfer your consciousness, hijack local networks, and fight your way through a grim, cyberpunk-inspired underworld to recover a critical cold storage drive. Equip yourself with everything from a razor-sharp katana to high-caliber firearms, and prepare for the ultimate test: taking control of a massive Celetron mech to smash through your opposition.
​Experience the gripping prologue, intense combat mechanics, and atmospheric level design firsthand.
summary: 5th Dimension is a cyberpunk world builder and RPG MMO that empowers players to create, and then control a limitless virtual world. Build game worlds, design high-tech robotic humanoids and compete in an array of adrenaline fuelled competitions to exert your influence on the world you’ve built.
